newsitem.title: USA: TCF says Winthrop merger three pct dilutive.
newsitem.headline: TCF says Winthrop merger three pct dilutive.

text.p: TCF Financial Corp said its $326-million acquisition of Winthrop Resources Corp, for which it signed a definitive agreement Friday, will be about three percent dilutive to its earnings in the first full year.
TCF said earlier the stock-swap deal would become accretive after the first full year after it closes.
TCF will issue 6.1 million shares, providing 0.7766 of one of its shares for each Winthrop share in a deal expected to close by the end of the second quarter of 1997.
TCF is a bank holding company, while Winthrop is an equipment leasing company.
TCF shares closed down 1/8 Friday at 45-3/8, while Winthrop finished off 5/8 at 32-1/2.
